basic_details.job_title: IIT Hyderabad Project Accountant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Wadhwani Innovation Network (WIN) Centre of Excellence (CoE) at the Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad, an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, is filling one Project Accountant post (UR) purely on a contractual basis. The engagement is initially for 11 months at a consolidated remuneration of Rs.40,000 – Rs.45,000/- per month. Applicants need a B.Com degree and a minimum of 3 years of post-qualification experience, with an upper age limit of 40 years. Applications are online only at careers.iith.ac.in/jobs/62, from 17 November 2026 t

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 40 years. Relaxation in the upper age limit is applicable in cases of horizontal reservation as per GoI rules. The notice does not list the relaxation amounts. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

qualification.details: Post Essential Qualification Project Accountant Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com) from a recognized University/Institute; proficiency in accounting software (such as Tally/ERP systems), MS Office (especially Excel), and financial reporting. | Experience: minimum 3 years of post-qualification experience in accounting, financial management, project accounting, handling project funds, budget monitoring, utilization certificates and financial documentation in Government organizations, Autonomous Bodies, Universities, Research Institutions or reputed private organizations. Sound knowledge of statutory compliance, GST, TDS, income tax regulations and financial audit procedures. Only relevant experience gained after the minimum qualifying degree or course is counted. Part-time employment experience is not considered. Educational qualifications must be from a recognized Board/Council/University/Institute. For a highly meritorious candidate, the selection committee may relax any experience criteria.

how_to_apply: Open the application link given in the notice, https://careers.iith.ac.in/jobs/62.
Register with a valid and active email ID that stays functional throughout the recruitment. Call letters, notifications and updates are sent only to this email ID.

Fill in the personal information. Upload a recent passport-size colour photograph and signature (JPG/JPEG, 1 MB; photograph taken within the last one month). Enter the name as recorded in the 10th Standard/Matriculation certificate.
Add educational qualifications through "Add Education" and employment details through "Add Employment". Upload supporting documents in PDF format, maximum 1 MB per document.
Upload category certificates where applicable and any additional certificates through "Add Certificate".
Open "Review & Submit", verify the details, accept the Declaration and submit.
After final submission, a PDF copy of the application is sent automatically to the registered email ID. A printout need not be sent to the Institute.
The notice also mentions the careers page https://iith.ac.in/careers/ (under Temporary Positions) for accessing the online form. No correction of details is entertained after final submission.
Experience, caste, educational and proof of date of birth certificates, uploaded as per the instructions.

Experience letter on the organisation's letterhead, stating designation, period of service, nature of work assignment(s) and pay, with date of issue, name and designation of the issuing authority, signature and stamp. Pay slips, office orders and appointment orders are not accepted as proof of experience.
SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS certificates in the prescribed Government of India format. The OBC certificate must be issued within the last two years and the EWS certificate for the current financial year.
Ex-servicemen certificate and PwBD certificate (disability of 40% or more), where applicable.
Self-attested copies of educational, caste and experience certificates, with originals, for verification at the interview, written test or skill test.
important_instructions: Only online applications are accepted. Offline applications will be summarily rejected. If any information or claim is found false at any stage, the candidature is cancelled. If the person is already appointed, services are terminated without notice or compensation. Applications are summarily rejected if the relevant certificates are not uploaded as per the instructions. Selection is subject to pre-engagement formalities: document checking and a medical fitness certificate. A candidate working elsewhere must submit an original release/relieving letter at joining. Medical facilities for contract employees are limited to outpatient treatment (OPD) in medical emergencies, at Rs. 100/- for normal OPD and Rs. 200/- for Specialists (rates subject to change). No reimbursement of medical expenses is admissible. The selected candidate must hold a valid health insurance policy for the engagement period at their own expense and submit a copy at joining. No Travelling Allowance (TA)/DA is paid for attending the selections. Canvassing in any form, directly or indirectly, amounts to rejection of candidature. All corrigenda and updates on this recruitment will be posted only on the Institute's website.

content_sections.heading: About IIT Hyderabad
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad is located at Kandi, Sangareddy, Telangana – 502284, and describes itself as an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. This post sits in its Wadhwani Innovation Network (WIN) Centre of Excellence (CoE). The notice is issued by the Registrar, IIT Hyderabad.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The number of advertised posts is tentative. The notice says the actual number may increase or decrease depending on the requirement.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must be citizens of India. The cut-off date for reckoning the upper age limit, qualification and post-qualification experience is the last date of online submission, 17-12-2026. Experience: minimum 3 years of post-qualification experience in accounting, financial management, project accounting, handling project funds, budget monitoring, utilization certificates and financial documentation in Government organizations, Autonomous Bodies, Universities, Research Institutions or reputed private organizations. Sound knowledge of statutory compliance, GST, TDS, income tax regulations and financial audit procedures. Only relevant experience gained after the minimum qualifying degree or course is counted. Part-time employment experience is not considered. Educational qualifications must be from a recognized Board/Council/University/Institute. For a highly meritorious candidate, the selection committee may relax any experience criteria. The upper age limit is 40 years. Relaxation in the upper age limit is applicable in cases of horizontal reservation as per GoI rules. The notice does not list the relaxation amounts. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com) from a recognized University/Institute; proficiency in accounting software (such as Tally/ERP systems), MS Office (especially Excel), and financial reporting.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated remuneration is subject to statutory deductions, as applicable. The appointment is purely temporary for 11 months. Further extension may be granted subject to satisfactory performance and the requirement of the Institute. The contract can be terminated at any time during the contract period with one month's notice from either side. Working hours are 8 hours per day, 6 days a week. The appointee must also work on weekends or holidays when informed by the Head of the Department, Faculty-in-Charge or Chairperson. Contractual employees are not eligible for campus residential accommodation. The Institute may consider allotment case-to-case, depending on the essentiality of services, availability and payment of the license fee at an appropriate rate.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Accountant vacancies has IIT Hyderabad announced?
faq.answer: The notice announces 01 vacancy, marked UR. The number is tentative and may increase or decrease depending on the requirement.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Hyderabad Project Accountant post?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online application is 17-12-2026. Applications opened on 17-11-2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the IIT Hyderabad Project Accountant post?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com) from a recognized University/Institute is required. Proficiency in accounting software, MS Office and financial reporting is also needed, along with a minimum of 3 years of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIT Hyderabad Project Accountant post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years, counted as on the last date of online submission, 17-12-2026. Relaxation applies in cases of horizontal reservation as per GoI rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the IIT Hyderabad Project Accountant?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs.40,000 – Rs.45,000/- per month, subject to statutory deductions as applicable.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the IIT Hyderabad Project Accountant post?
faq.answer: Apply online through https://careers.iith.ac.in/jobs/62 and upload the required certificates. A printout need not be submitted, and offline applications are rejected.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The mode of selection is Written Test/Skill test/Interview at IIT Hyderabad, Kandi, Sanagreddy. Candidates bring self-attested copies and originals of certificates for verification.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Project Accountant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely on a contractual basis, initially for 11 months. Extension is possible subject to satisfactory performance and the Institute's requirement, and gives no right or claim to employment in IITH.

faq.question: Q9. Will IIT Hyderabad pay travelling allowance for attending the selection?
faq.answer: No Travelling Allowance (TA)/DA is paid to candidates for attending the selections.

faq.question: Q10. Can campus accommodation be allotted to a contract Project Accountant?
faq.answer: Contractual employees are not eligible for campus accommodation. The Institute may consider allotment case-to-case, depending on the essentiality of services and availability, subject to payment of the license fee at an appropriate rate.
